title: 50% work
text: 50% work. 50% of them work.  I ordered two sets of these lights.  If they work they are beautiful.  I bought these in December but had to wait to put them out when the weather got nicer.  Out of the eight only four work.  What I do like about them is they have an off and on button underneath.  I have gone out each night to make sure that the ones that don't work are on the on position, and they are.  Too bad since these are nice when they work.
